RISE & Shine: Language-Oriented Compiler Design

Michel Steuwer1 Thomas Kœhler2 Bastian Köpcke3 Federico Pizzuti1 Affiliation: 1University of Edinburgh, Scotland, UK 2University of Glasgow, Scotland, UK 3University of Münster, Germany
Email: michel.steuwer@ed.ac.uk, thomas.koehler@thok.eu, bastian.koepcke@wwu.de, federico.pizzuti@ed.ac.uk
Abstract
The trend towards specialization of software and hardware — fueled by the end of Moore’s law and the still accelerating interest in domain-specific computing, such as machine learning — forces us to radically rethink our compiler designs.

IV Clearly Separating Optimizing from Code Generation

One main principle observed in the Shine compiler is the clear separation of IRs for optimizing and code generation.
